top_choice_rationale: P003 honours a bounded and mature achievement: the magic-wavelength optical lattice clock, which cancels the differential light shift so that many atoms can be interrogated in the Lamb-Dicke regime and brought to the 10^-18 level. It is a distinct principle from the 2005 comb and 2012 ion-control prizes, has been reproduced with Sr, Yb and Hg in many laboratories, and has a clean two-name proposal-plus-realisation allocation. P001 is a close second: a complete prediction-to-observation arc with two decades of confirmation, but the Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang step between Kane-Mele and the HgTe experiment cannot be cleanly credited within three names. P002 ranks third because seven years after the 2018 experiments the pairing mechanism is open and the credit leaves out the co-first authors. All three are preferable to no award.
recusal_note: No specific conflict with Katori or Ye is apparent from my profile; my documented collaborations (L'Huillier, Lund, Keller at ETH, Schuch, Dahlstrom, Argenti, Indelicato) involve none of the credited names in P001, P002 or P003.
